label: spokesperson for
definition: Person X serves as a spokesperson or expressly speaks for person or organization Y.
scope_notes: Spokesman/spokeswoman is the strongest recurring specific role and preserves the prior spokesperson predicate. This cluster also contains a substantial broader managerial/director component; those offices alone do not imply a spokesperson role, and this scope does not union them. Predicate choice is material in this mixed cluster.
